title: "mitox get OTU's"
author: "Caroline Wheeler"
date: '2022-11-30'
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
taxa <- read.csv("../data/mpa_aggregated_long_10-5-22.csv")
```

split taxa column by taxonomic level
```{r}
taxa <- taxa %>%
  separate(Taxonomy, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), '\\|') %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species))

otu <- taxa %>% 
  select(sample, Species) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
```

```{r}
write.csv(otu, "../data/mitox_speciesCounts.csv")
```
